The Battle of Guam took place from February 1 to March 26, 1941, during the initial invasion of Japan by its forces in the Pacific Theater. The Battle of Manila, which was a major urban combat operation that began on April 12, 1945, during the Philippine–Indonesia conflict following the Japanese surrender, occurred later.
